faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What you need to know about building a Telegram bot on IrForge.
faq.q1: How do I make a Telegram bot without coding?
faq.a1: Get a token from BotFather and paste it into IrForge. The webhook, profile and hosting are handled for you, so you can create a Telegram bot without writing a line of code. If you do write code, you can drop down to it for command logic whenever you want.
faq.q2: Is it free to create a Telegram bot here?
faq.a2: Yes — you can start free and build and test your first bot without a credit card. Paid plans add more bots and more capacity.
faq.q3: How long does it take to set up the bot builder?
faq.a3: Usually a few minutes. Your bot goes live as soon as the token is in; after that you add commands, install plugins, and publish changes with no downtime.
faq.q4: Can I build a store or support bot?
faq.a4: Yes. Custom commands plus payment, moderation and AI-reply plugins cover shop bots, customer-support bots and most other workflows.
faq.q5: Where do I learn how to build a Telegram bot?
faq.a5: Start with the documentation: quick start, defining commands with arguments, and writing a plugin are all covered with working examples.

learnBotToken.title: How do I get my bot token?
learnBotToken.subtitle: Every Telegram bot is created by BotFather, Telegram's own bot. It takes about a minute and gives you a token — the key IrForge uses to run your bot.
learnBotToken.step1Body: Use any Telegram app you already have — phone, desktop or web. You need to be signed in to your own account.
learnBotToken.step2Body: Search for @BotFather and open the chat. It is Telegram's official bot for creating bots — check for the blue verified badge before you start.
learnBotToken.step3Body: Type /newbot and send it. BotFather will walk you through the two questions below.
learnBotToken.step4Body: This is the name people see at the top of the chat, for example "My Shop". You can change it later, and it may contain spaces and any language.
learnBotToken.step5Body: The username is unique and permanent, and must end in "bot" — for example my_shop_bot. If the name is taken, BotFather asks for another one.
learnBotToken.step6Body: BotFather replies with a line that looks like the example below. That whole string is your token — copy it exactly, with no extra spaces.
learnBotToken.step7Body: Come back here, paste the token into the bot token field at checkout, and finish the order. IrForge connects to your bot from that point on.
learnBotToken.warningBody: Anyone holding the token has full control of your bot — they can read its messages and act as it. Never share it, never post it in a group or a screenshot, and never commit it to a public repository.
learnBotToken.warningRevoke: If a token has leaked, open @BotFather, send /revoke and pick the bot. The old token stops working immediately and you get a new one to paste in here.
learnBotToken.channelBody: Our education channel carries video walkthroughs of this guide and the rest of IrForge — setup, plugins, payments and more.
learnBotToken.nextBody: Head back to checkout and paste it in to finish creating your bot.
